gates.notes: Immutable upstream revision is now pinned to 9d2b6ace3e23199e2a896de329d4c16489b09a96. The top-level README identifies FUNIT/ and base/modules/modules.py as third-party exceptions; dependency-closure license audit and reproducible baseline execution remain incomplete, so this gate remains BLOCKED.

Conditional project approval now documented for all 52 exact files across 20 families. The pinned SIL OFL 1.1 snapshots pass integrity checks. Official SIL OFL-FAQ 1.1-update8 Q1.25 and Q3.9 permit AI-based font generation subject to generated font software remaining OFL-1.1, preserving copyright/acknowledgements, and avoiding Reserved Font Names without permission. This is not an NC license and does not determine model-weight licensing.

GitHub Actions downloaded and audited the actual published font and glyph release archives. Result: 7,904 samples, 52 font files, 20 families, family splits train=14/validation=3/test=3, all 7,904 referenced images verified, zero audit errors. The prior duplicate warning was a false positive caused by the audit tool reading target_index instead of target_index_logical; fixed and covered by a regression test.

Latest GitHub Actions run built 1,872 isolated single-codepoint crops from the published 52-font/20-family corpus and passed the independent crop audit with zero rejected crops. These are isolated forms only; they do not replace contextual joining, ligature, or combining-mark cluster supervision, and legal training permission remains separately blocked.

Generated 1,732 paired factual Arabic/English captions and measurable component/raster geometry records, tied to exact source text, Unicode 17 metadata, HarfBuzz mappings, image hashes, and family splits. Captions are synthetic factual templates, not reviewed style descriptions or semantic calligraphic prompts; all records remain unapproved and training-ineligible.

Executable shared raster decoder and image/text/hybrid conditioning paths now pass CPU forward/backward smoke tests. Text conditioning is a Unicode codepoint GRU, not a pretrained semantic Arabic language encoder; this is an experimental baseline, not the pinned MX-Font adapter or a quality-validated generator.

The latest base CI run passed 51 tests (4 optional PyTorch tests skipped there); a dedicated CPU PyTorch workflow separately passed 4 tests covering image/text/hybrid forward and backward, model checkpoint round-trip, optimizer-state resume, and Unicode codepoint encoding. Full dataset training, tiny-subset overfit, convergence, held-out-family evaluation, and real hardware resume remain unverified.
The local Windows preflight must be run on the actual machine; current GPU, VRAM, RAM, disk, backend compatibility, and runtime estimates are not established here.

Intermediate adapter code is committed. GitHub Actions successfully compiled both scripts and passed four deterministic episode-sampler unit tests. The crop builder has not been run against the user's local font archive; this PASS covers code compilation and sampler tests only.

Unicode 17.0 joining metadata registry structure validates; CI passed. Scope is basic Arabic alphabet plus two common extensions. Visual-family/dot metadata is explicitly provisional and does not constitute audited MX-Font component/decomposition labels.

CI generated and validated 1,413 assigned Script=Arabic records from pinned Unicode 17.0 UCD files with source hashes. This is script-level metadata, not a language-specific gold corpus or visual decomposition dataset.
Schema and validator implemented; this does not mean any glyphs have been annotated or independently reviewed.

GitHub Actions run 44527935025 completed the batch HarfBuzz regression for all 52 conditionally OFL-approved font files across 20 families. All 52 font paths and SHA-256 values passed the rights gate, and each font produced 10 shaping-case reports (520 font-case records total). This records the exact HarfBuzz output for the regression strings; it does not prove visual correctness or complete Arabic coverage.
Per-component polygon agreement analyzer and unit tests passed. This validates the comparison tool, not actual human agreement; no real double-annotated pilot has yet been created.

Conditional OFL rights manifest generated and validated in GitHub Actions run 44527370231. It contains 52 per-file records across 20 families, with exact SHA-256 values, pinned OFL URLs, license snapshot hashes, copyright lines, and RFN candidates. Every font path and SHA-256 matched the downloaded corpus. Training use is approved only with generated font files released under OFL-1.1 and all RFN/notices conditions met; model-weight licensing remains separate.

Fail-closed audit tool and tests are implemented. GitHub Actions run 44476157196 downloaded the published release archives and audited the actual published corpus successfully; all 30 repository unit tests passed.

Latest CI built 1,732 contextual cluster crops from 52 fonts/20 families. Independent audit reproduced all 1,732 glyph-ID mappings with zero integrity errors, preserved context-level non-rendering controls/separators, and verified images and split provenance. Coverage is PARTIAL: 518 of 520 font-case pairs are present; two Aref Ruqaa font files lack a renderable tatweel cluster and are explicitly reported/excluded. 238 multi-codepoint clusters remain. Integrity PASS for produced records does not establish visual/linguistic correctness or legal training rights.

Automated Unicode/ArabicShaping consistency audit passed for all 1,732 contextual clusters (2,022 codepoints, zero errors), and the independent HarfBuzz audit reproduced mappings for all generated clusters. These checks validate metadata and shaping reproducibility, not visual readability, spelling correctness, artistic quality, or human approval. The stratified review pack remains drafts only.

Generated 2,987 measurable 8-connected raster component candidates across 1,732 clusters, with normalized boxes, areas, centroids, and detached/main-component candidate flags. Every semantic component identity remains unknown; these are not approved body/dot/hamza/mark labels and do not replace expert decomposition annotations.

CI successfully generated and uploaded arabic-human-review-pack. Verified artifact: 100 visual/linguistic samples (10 per each of 10 shaping cases, 10 font families represented per case) and 40 geometry pilot samples drawn from the full eligible corpus, balanced over eight eligible cases. Separate 40-record draft ledgers for annotators A/B and adjudication tracker were included. This PASS certifies package generation and tests only; no human review or label approval has occurred.

Latest CI generated 100 stratified cluster-level drafts (10 for each of 10 shaping cases). Independent validation matched all 100 records to source clusters, checked schema-critical metadata and image hashes/dimensions, and reported zero errors. The pack contains 35 multi-codepoint samples, 26 multi-glyph samples, and 30 samples carrying omitted source controls/separators. All records remain drafts; this is not visual or linguistic approval.

Latest GitHub Actions run 44527604462 generated 1,732 visual-supervision records using the conditional OFL rights manifest. All 1,732 records now pass the per-font rights gate (train=1,134, validation=299, test=299 across 20 families). This means rights eligibility only; geometry is still machine-derived, and visual/spelling/artistic truth is not assessed.

CI verified pinned official Google Fonts license texts for 20 families covering all 52 exact font files, including OFL 1.1 markers, selected clauses, SHA-256 snapshots, copyright headers and reserved-name candidates. This is source/text evidence only; 0 ML-training approvals.

Unicode 17 / ArabicShaping audit passed on all 1,732 contextual clusters and 2,022 codepoints, including marks and contextual joining properties outside Script=Arabic scope; zero errors. It does not judge spelling, visual readability or calligraphic correctness.

CI generated 1,732 paired Arabic/English factual caption records and 2,987 8-connected raster component candidates. All component semantic identities are explicitly unknown; captions are synthetic and unreviewed. No record is expert-approved or training-eligible.

Independent audit passed on all 1,732 records: 2,987 component candidates, 3,464 paired Arabic/English captions, 20 families, split counts train=1,134/validation=299/test=299, zero errors, zero boundary-touching ink, and zero training-eligible records. This is integrity/geometric QA, not semantic or expert visual approval.
All three conditioning routes passed CPU forward/backward smoke tests. The text branch encodes Unicode codepoints, not word meaning or natural-language semantics.
